"""Canonicalization parity between zone data and observed data."""
import json, subprocess, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tests')
from harness import run, prof, query, rec, Checks

c = Checks()
P = prof('p', 4)

def audit(doc, expect_verdict, expect_different, label):
    rc, out, err = run(doc)
    if rc != 0 or not out.startswith(b'{"runs'):
        c.check(label, False, 'rc=%r out=%r err=%r' % (rc, out[:80], err[:200]))
        return
    got = json.loads(out)
    obs = got['audits'][0]
    if obs['verdict'] != expect_verdict or obs['different'] != expect_different:
        c.check(label, False, 'got %s want %s/%s' % (obs, expect_verdict, expect_different)
                + '\nruns: %s' % json.dumps(got['runs'])[:600])
        return
    c.check(label, True)

# zone stores the long form, observation the short form -> must match
doc = {'zones': [{'origin': 'test.', 'records': [
        rec('a.test.', 'AAAA', '2001:0DB8:0000:0000:0000:0000:0000:0001')]}],
       'profiles': [P],
       'queries': [query('qa', 'a.test.', 'AAAA', 1)],
       'observations': [{'id': 'o1', 'query': 'qa', 'profile': 'p',
                         'result': {'status': 'response', 'rcode': 'NOERROR',
                                    'answer': [rec('A.TEST.', 'AAAA', '2001:db8::1')]}}]}
audit(doc, 'match', [], 'long vs short AAAA canonicalization')

# IPv4-mapped literal: .compressed keeps the dotted-quad tail on both sides
doc = {'zones': [{'origin': 'test.', 'records': [
        rec('a.test.', 'AAAA', '::FFFF:192.0.2.1')]}],
       'profiles': [P],
       'queries': [query('qa', 'a.test.', 'AAAA', 1)],
       'observations': [{'id': 'o1', 'query': 'qa', 'profile': 'p',
                         'result': {'status': 'response', 'rcode': 'NOERROR',
                                    'answer': [rec('a.test.', 'AAAA', '::ffff:192.0.2.1')]}}]}
audit(doc, 'match', [], 'IPv4-mapped AAAA canonicalization')

# empty TXT payload is legal
doc = {'zones': [{'origin': 'test.', 'records': [rec('a.test.', 'TXT', '')]}],
       'profiles': [P],
       'queries': [query('qa', 'a.test.', 'TXT', 1)],
       'observations': [{'id': 'o1', 'query': 'qa', 'profile': 'p',
                         'result': {'status': 'response', 'rcode': 'NOERROR',
                                    'answer': [rec('a.test.', 'TXT', '')]}}]}
audit(doc, 'match', [], 'empty TXT payload')

# owner case folding on both sides
doc = {'zones': [{'origin': 'TeSt.', 'records': [rec('A.tEsT.', 'AAAA', '0:0::1')]}],
       'profiles': [P],
       'queries': [query('qa', 'A.TEST.', 'AAAA', 1)],
       'observations': [{'id': 'o1', 'query': 'qa', 'profile': 'p',
                         'result': {'status': 'response', 'rcode': 'NOERROR',
                                    'answer': [rec('A.TEST.', 'AAAA', '::1')]}}]}
audit(doc, 'match', [], 'name case folding on owner and target')

# CNAME target case folding
doc = {'zones': [{'origin': 'test.', 'records': [rec('a.test.', 'CNAME', 'EnD.test.'),
                                                rec('END.test.', 'A', '192.0.2.3')]}],
       'profiles': [P],
       'queries': [query('qa', 'a.test.', 'A', 1)],
       'observations': [{'id': 'o1', 'query': 'qa', 'profile': 'p',
                         'result': {'status': 'response', 'rcode': 'NOERROR',
                                    'answer': [rec('a.test.', 'CNAME', 'end.test.'),
                                               rec('end.test.', 'A', '192.0.2.3')]}}]}
audit(doc, 'match', [], 'CNAME target case folding')

# an answer whose only difference is extra/missing type/design differences
doc = {'zones': [{'origin': 'test.', 'records': [rec('a.test.', 'A', '10.0.0.1'),
                                                rec('a.test.', 'A', '10.0.0.2')]}],
       'profiles': [P],
       'queries': [query('qa', 'a.test.', 'A', 1)],
       'observations': [{'id': 'o1', 'query': 'qa', 'profile': 'p',
                         'result': {'status': 'response', 'rcode': 'NOERROR',
                                    'answer': [rec('a.test.', 'A', '10.0.0.1')]}}]}
audit(doc, 'divergence', ['answer'], 'subset answer is a divergence')

# order and duplicates must not matter
doc = {'zones': [{'origin': 'test.', 'records': [rec('a.test.', 'A', '10.0.0.1'),
                                                rec('a.test.', 'A', '10.0.0.2')]}],
       'profiles': [P],
       'queries': [query('qa', 'a.test.', 'A', 1)],
       'observations': [{'id': 'o1', 'query': 'qa', 'profile': 'p',
                         'result': {'status': 'response', 'rcode': 'NOERROR',
                                    'answer': [rec('a.test.', 'A', '10.0.0.2'),
                                               rec('a.test.', 'A', '10.0.0.1'),
                                               rec('a.test.', 'A', '10.0.0.2')]}}]}
audit(doc, 'match', [], 'order and duplicates ignored')

# same RDATA but different owner -> divergence
doc = {'zones': [{'origin': 'test.', 'records': [rec('a.test.', 'A', '10.0.0.1')]}],
       'profiles': [P],
       'queries': [query('qa', 'a.test.', 'A', 1)],
       'observations': [{'id': 'o1', 'query': 'qa', 'profile': 'p',
                         'result': {'status': 'response', 'rcode': 'NOERROR',
                                    'answer': [rec('b.test.', 'A', '10.0.0.1')]}}]}
audit(doc, 'divergence', ['answer'], 'owner only difference is visible')

sys.exit(c.done('canonicalization tests'))
